record.question: The Indian Parliament has passed the Personal Laws (Amendment) Bill 2019 that seeks to remove which of the following diseases as a ground for divorce?
record.explanation: Answer B: Leprosy. The Personal Laws (Amendment) Act, 2019 amended the listed personal-law statutes to remove leprosy as a ground; the Act’s text is the controlling evidence. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/repealedfileopen?rfilename=A2019-06.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
